sql.query: UPDATE tbl_generated_contracts gc SET gc.contractName=:contractName,gc.renderedHtml=:renderedHtml,gc.draftModifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,gc.draftModifiedByUserId=:userId,gc.modifiedByUserId=:userId2,gc.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status='draft' AND NULLIF(TRIM(:nameCheck),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:htmlCheck),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
